notes.title: Meet the Cauterizer!
notes.notes: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44045978/945524d2dd4a82d30d9adf6649f1a86b419f3eae.png"][/img][/h1][h1]Feel The Burn! [/h1][p][/p][p]Cauterizers are our newest enemy type, and they can be found in the Arena as of the 0.7.3 update to Transfusion. [/p][p][/p][p]Unlike all the enemies up to this point, which rush and overwhelm you, this fearsome foe will try to keep its distance and throw fireballs from afar![/p][p][/p][p]These fireballs deal a considerable amount of damage, but take note that you're not the only one that can get hurt by them...[/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes 0.7.3[/h2][h3]Updates:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new enemy type - Cauterizers. These enemies will attempt to keep their distance and throw fireballs at the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Added graphics settings in settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added “holsters” at the player’s sides to hold weapons when not in use[/p][/*][*][p]Added invisible walls while platforms are raising with new enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy tails now move with ragdoll physics[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Some changes to the save system to track settings separately from game progress[/p][/*][*][p]Movement vignette now accounts for vertical movement in addition to horizontal[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Achievements Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Keep an eye out for an update this Friday where we'll be dropping a few updates to the Arcade mode, some visual and audio updates, and adding our first Achievements!

Heads up - the achievements will be active on Steam for a couple days beforehand for testing purposes, they'll be unlockable after the patch this Friday!

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where depending on play space, the player could spawn on the arena elevator outside of the trigger for making it go up to start the level

notes.title: Transfusion is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
We've hit the big green button, and now you can play the early access version of our game!

We're a small group of hobbyists, we've been working on this in our off-time for the better part of three years, and we're so proud to be able to share what we've made with you. We hope you enjoy it.

We're going to continue adding content and polish, so if you have any feedback for us please join the discord, or reach out on Bluesky or the community tab of YouTube to let us know what you think - you could help steer the direction of the final release!

To everyone that's kept up with the project over the years, playtested our numerous rough drafts, pitched in a helping hand, offered feedback and advice - from the bottom of our hearts, thank you!

notes.title: Transfusion Release - January 13th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44045978/6d2a0d1e55104a44877eed20be59cb4f801b3893.png[/img][h1]Hey Everyone[/h1]

We're so exited to release the game in Early Access next week! It's been a crazy 3-year journey creating the game so far, and it's awesome to have something that we're ready to share with the world.

Our initial release will have a fully playable Arcade mode version of the game, and as we continue to work on the game we'll be adding new content and working on a Story Mode! 

Thank you for checking out our game, and we hope you enjoy!
